providers.name: Insurance Canopy
providers.notes: Veracity program. Strong fit for importers / manufacturers / distributors of consumer products; product liability including trade-show coverage and product-withdrawal. Online application, quote in 48-72h.
providers.submit_note: Online application; you will see 'Application submitted successfully' and a quote follows in 48-72h. The application IS the submission.

field_hints.note: Pick the product-liability program that matches your products, not a generic BOP.

field_hints.value: Yes - imports and private-labels its own brand
field_hints.note: Disclose importer status + country of origin up front; this market is built for it.

providers.name: Veracity Insurance
providers.notes: Parent of Insurance Canopy. Writes product / foreign / international liability. No consumer quote form - agent/phone only (see veracityinsurance.com).
providers.submit_note: No online consumer form. Submission happens by phone/agent.
providers.manual_note: Call Veracity's listed agent line (see veracityinsurance.com) - there is no self-serve form. Easiest path is via Insurance Canopy (its consumer-facing program).

providers.name: XINSURANCE
providers.notes: Evolution Insurance Brokers. Hard-to-place / imported / high-hazard / product liability; limits to $20M. Quote-request form; team contacts within ~24 business hours.
providers.submit_note: Quote-request form, not an instant quote. Their team contacts you within ~24 business hours.

providers.name: Insureon
providers.notes: Multi-carrier digital agency, shops 100+ carriers (Hiscox, Hartford, Liberty, etc.). Completes the quote by phone. Shares leads with Tivly.
providers.submit_note: The lead is captured at the CONTACT step (phone + Next). Insureon then completes the quote by PHONE.

providers.name: Simply Business
providers.notes: Marketplace across ~18 carriers (Coterie, Hiscox, Markel, Travelers, CNA, Arch, RLI, biBerk...). Returns INSTANT online quotes for many low-to-moderate-hazard classes.
providers.submit_note: Instant quotes - the QUOTE step (not the contact step) is the real submit. Decline marketing/SMS consents.

providers.name: Coterie Insurance
providers.notes: Digital direct carrier, fast GL/BOP for low-to-moderate-hazard classes. Often reached through a marketplace.
providers.submit_note: Often reached through a marketplace (e.g. Simply Business) rather than direct.

providers.name: Hiscox
providers.notes: Online quote/bind, instant COI, blanket additional insured. Strong service / professional / retail / light-manufacturing appetite; partial fit for importers.
providers.submit_note: Instant online quote/bind. The quote step is the submit.

providers.name: The Hartford
providers.notes: Broad small-business appetite with strong wholesale/distribution lines, BUT its automated underwriting declines the imported private-label 'deemed manufacturer' class online (routes to a partner marketplace). Solid for non-importer classes.
providers.submit_note: Online quote may route you to an agent. For the importer class it hard-stops and hands off to a lead-match partner.

providers.name: biBerk
providers.notes: Berkshire Hathaway direct writer, instant online bind. Low-hazard service / retail / office classes; does not write importer / distributor / manufacturer product classes.
providers.submit_note: Instant online bind; the quote step is the submit.

providers.name: Next Insurance (ERGO NEXT)
providers.notes: Digital direct carrier, instant online. Strong for trades, contractors, and low-hazard retail/service; restricts private-label / importers (likely decline for that class).
providers.submit_note: Instant online quote; the quote step is the submit.

providers.name: CoverWallet (Aon)
providers.notes: Aon-owned digital agency/broker, online + phone, multi-carrier across many industries. Appetite is carrier-dependent.
providers.submit_note: Online application plus phone follow-up; lead can be captured at the contact step.

providers.name: Thimble
providers.notes: Markel-backed, instant online. Built for gig workers, events, contractors, and makers; weak importer fit.
providers.submit_note: Instant online quote; the quote step is the submit.

providers.name: Embroker
providers.notes: Digital MGA/brokerage focused on startups, tech, and professional-services lines. Weak product-liability fit.

providers.name: Tivly
providers.notes: Lead-match marketplace across 350+ carriers covering most industries. Phone-transfer model, not instant self-serve. Other agencies route declined/overflow leads here, so it can reach specialty and hard-to-place markets.
providers.submit_note: Phone-transfer / lead-match: entering your phone connects you to a matched carrier by phone. It is NOT an instant self-serve quote, and submitting the form is a marketing/contact consent.

providers.name: Supersure
providers.notes: UNVERIFIED. Tech-enabled business-insurance brokerage licensed in all 50 states, 50+ carriers, app-based; markets GL/BOP for small businesses across industries. Importer/private-label appetite NOT confirmed - treat as carrier-dependent until verified.
providers.submit_note: Online quote with licensed-agent follow-up; the lead can be captured at the contact step.
providers.manual_note: UNVERIFIED entry - confirm URL, carrier panel, appetite, and that any placed carrier has no foreign-products exclusion before relying on this.
